title: Star Life Cycle
guideExplore: A star's fate depends on its mass. Follow stages from nebula to remnant.
guideLow: Low-mass path — ends as a white dwarf, like the Sun.
guideHigh: High-mass path — supernova, then neutron star or black hole.
conditionsHint: Mass decides the death path: low-mass stars become white dwarfs; high-mass stars can explode.
quizQuestion: A Sun-like star ends its life mainly as a…
learnMore: More mass means stronger gravity — after the red giant phase, massive stars can go supernova.
